name: Hyena
notes: Hyena Hierarchy per arXiv:2302.10866 (ICML 2023). Subquadratic drop-in replacement for attention: interleaves implicitly parametrized long convolutions with data-controlled gating. 'Hyena operators are twice as fast as highly optimized attention at sequence length 8K, and 100x faster at sequence length 64K.' Reaches Transformer quality with 20% training compute reduction at 2K. Research-only adoption - no production engine support. [ID renamed from 'hyena-hierarchy' to 'hyena-arch' to avoid collision with papers/hyena-hierarchy. Source fixed from non-existent 'hyena' to 'pap-arch-2302-10866'.]
